title: Can this warehouse absorb the query arrival rate?
description: Enter an arrival rate, a runtime observed on the selected size, and safe concurrency measured for one cluster. The lab calculates a queueing envelope; it does not predict Snowflake performance.
rateNote: Gen1 credit rates are documented compute-unit rates, not currency prices. Actual billing also depends on provisioned seconds, the 60-second minimum each time compute starts, warehouse generation, cloud, region, edition, and contract.
editionNote: More than one cluster models a multi-cluster warehouse, which requires Enterprise Edition or higher. Actual auto-scale clusters start and stop from workload demand, so the reference-credit result assumes all selected clusters run for the full window.
